note: Human-reviewed display names that override the models.dev transcription with the provider's own published spelling. Keyed by provider/model. An entry exists only where the two disagree: pinning a name that already matches would shadow a future upstream correction with a stale copy. Every entry quotes the provider's official documentation inside its public repository.

opencode-zen/mimo-v2.5-free.ref: opencode docs zen.mdx endpoints table, row mimo-v2.5-free
evidence: The official Zen documentation lists the model as 'MiMo-V2.5 Free' (hyphenated) with id mimo-v2.5-free, priced Free in every column.
models.dev currently publishes the name as 'MiMo V2.5 Free' (spaced), which does not match the provider's own spelling.

opencode-zen/muse-spark-1.2-contributor-.ref: opencode docs zen.mdx endpoints and pricing tables, row muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free
evidence: The official Zen documentation lists the model as 'Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor Free' with id muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free, priced Free in every column.

'Contributor' names the Meta contributor tier — free usage in exchange for permission to train on prompts and completions, per the same page's data-use section. Omitting it hides the consent distinction that separates this offering from a plain free tier.
models.dev currently publishes the name as 'Muse Spark 1.2 Free', which omits the tier marker.
